Description: In Victoria Maseko’s room, Damian Maseko directly questions Annie Beaumont about the stolen pocket watch. Annie denies involvement but points suspicion at Tony Dauer, and for the first time mentions a “weirdo” who has been wandering around the house for a long time.
Location: Victoria Maseko's room（Vic's room）
Key Information:
  - Damian Maseko directly asks Annie Beaumont where the pocket watch is, focusing the conversation on the theft.
  - Annie Beaumont denies involvement and repeatedly insists she has nothing to do with it.
  - Damian Maseko notes Annie Beaumont and Tony Dauer were whispering during dinner, and that Tony later claimed he needed to fetch something—suggesting suspicious behavior.
  - Annie Beaumont claims she has never been to Helen Dauer’s room (Helen's room).
  - Annie Beaumont admits she spoke with Tony Dauer and guesses he may have hidden the pocket watch elsewhere.
  - Annie Beaumont says she went to the Living room before dinner began, and at that time Helen Dauer was the only person there.
  - Thunder occurs during the conversation as a recurring environmental cue across scenes.
  - Annie Beaumont clearly states she does not know Rupert Galley.
  - Annie Beaumont says she has seen a strange person wandering around the house and suspects he lived here long ago; she says she will go question him.
  - Damian Maseko advises Annie Beaumont to be tactful when conveying information, especially since the strange person may be related to the deceased.
  - The narrator notes Annie Beaumont’s final remark carries a strong tone of sarcasm.
Characters:
  [Annie Beaumont（Annie Beaumont）] Person No. 2.
    · Denies involvement in the pocket watch theft and denies having been to Helen Dauer’s room.
    · Admits speaking with Tony Dauer and suspects he may have hidden the pocket watch.
    · States she went to the Living room before dinner and saw only Helen Dauer there.
    · Clearly states she does not know Rupert Galley.
    · Mentions a strange person wandering around the house who may have lived here long ago, and says she will go ask him.
  [Damian Maseko（Damian Maseko）] Person No. 8.
    · Presses Annie Beaumont directly about the theft, using Tony Dauer’s suspicious behavior as leverage.
    · After Annie denies involvement, asks whether she can provide any leads.
    · Advises Annie Beaumont to be restrained and empathetic when speaking to relevant people.
